item.title: 5-year SASE forecast reaches $97B as spending nearly triples – Dell'Oro
item.description: Security risk, not routing, is driving SASE. #pressrelease

item.title: Ericsson and Nokia see their sales in China fall off a cliff
item.description: Revenues generated in the China region by Ericsson and Nokia fell sharply last year as geopolitics continued to intrude.

item.title: KKR and Singtel take full ownership of STT GDC in landmark $5.1B deal
item.description: The acquisition would give STT GDC an enterprise value of SG$13.8 billion (approximately $10.9 billion), including leverage and capital expenditure for committed projects.

item.title: Eurobites: VMO2 automates mobile network management with Zinkworks
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: UK SMEs regret running out of mobile data; Cellnex restructures; Ericsson targets SA mining sector.

item.title: AT&T, Charter, Comcast named in ICE-related 'Resist and Unsubscribe' campaign
item.description: A new campaign led by entrepreneur and investor Scott Galloway urges users to ditch services from companies that are 'active enablers' of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), including AT&T, Charter and Comcast.

item.title: IQ Fiber hires Doug Guthrie as COO
item.description: IQ Fiber has tapped Doug Guthrie in the new role of COO. Guthrie has prior posts with Cable One, Astound and Comcast. #pressrelease

item.title: Amdocs goes all-in for agentic AI with telco OS platform
item.description: Amdocs unveils an agentic operating system for telecoms to manage AI agents in telco IT stacks and announces successor for CEO Shuky Sheffer who is retiring at the end of March.

item.title: Gilat nets $10M order to support a LEO constellation
item.description: Gilat Satellite Networks has received an order for more than $10 million from a ground gateway antenna provider to support an ongoing rollout of a low-Earth orbit system. #pressrelease

item.title: SCTE Foundation details new mentoring pilot program
item.description: SCTE Foundation has moved ahead with a 'NextGen Mentoring Pilot,' a new six-month program designed to support rising technical and operational talent across the broadband ecosystem. The inaugural cohort includes 40 participants. #pressrelease

item.title: Musk's massive space-based data center: Super scale or sheer folly?
item.description: The concept of orbital data centers is 'conceivable,' say some analysts. But SpaceX's plan to deploy space-based data centers underpinned by a staggering 1 million satellites faces massive technical, operational and financial challenges.
